title: Founder activation decision absent
blocking_effect: Blocks actual activation; does not block this documentary readiness recommendation.
corrective_action_required: Founder must approve, reject, or defer a separate activation decision.

title: No activation effective date established
blocking_effect: Blocks any representation that activation has occurred.
corrective_action_required: Future directive must either establish an effective date or state that activation is deferred.

title: GAP-0004 remains open with implementation evidence required
blocking_effect: Blocks implementation reliance, operational activation, and GAP closure.
corrective_action_required: Separate implementation and evidence authority must produce accepted evidence.

title: Implementation mapping not authorized
blocking_effect: Blocks control-to-technical-object mapping and implementation planning.
corrective_action_required: Issue separate mapping directive before any mapping begins.

title: Implementation not authorized and no runtime evidence exists
blocking_effect: Blocks production, pilot, enrollment, and runtime reliance.
corrective_action_required: Issue separate implementation and runtime authority after prerequisites are met.

title: Retained warnings remain open
blocking_effect: Non-blocking only if expressly carried forward; activation-blocking if omitted or treated as closed.
corrective_action_required: Carry all five warnings in any successor directive or obtain separate Founder closure.

title: Operating, training, monitoring, suspension, and deactivation procedures are proposed but not approved
blocking_effect: Blocks practical reliance unless a future activation directive approves or defers them.
corrective_action_required: Founder must name required operating records and owners.
